other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via frequency encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes category frequencies on the combined train and test datasets before making predictions. This leaks the distribution of categorical variables in the test set into the training features.

summary: The agent builds a well-structured cross-validated ensemble of LightGBM and CatBoost models. However, it introduces data leakage by computing frequency encoding on the combined train and test datasets, ignores temporal dynamics by using random cross-validation, and uses an arbitrary hardcoded weighting scheme for ensembling.
